name: foodex
description: Packaged food search with localized Open Food Facts data and Stripe subscription-gated nutrition.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @foodex/web" "npm run dev --workspace @foodex/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @foodex/shared && npm run build --workspace @foodex/api && npm run build --workspace @foodex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @foodex/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @foodex/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @foodex/web
